subject: Structuring incentives for HIPAA + HSM pilot
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@medicos.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Structuring incentives for HIPAA + HSM pilot

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I’m attaching a draft of the pilot terms and a short spreadsheet that lays out two incentive paths for Medicos’ HIPAA pilot:

- Option A (Seat-focused): One-time implementation credit + discounted HSM seats for first 3 months; SLA uplift option for pilot.
- Option B (Throughput-focused): Monthly throughput credits applied as a dollar-per-million-token credit for first 90 days after pilot start; audit-log retention tier included.

High level ask from your side: confirm whether procurement needs credits to be reflected on an invoice (yes/no), and whether you can commit to a PO by 9 June to secure the pilot pricing. If procurement needs a lower upfront credit we can discuss splitting implementation credit across invoice milestones.

Attachments: Medicos-MA-REDWOOD-draft-terms.pdf, pilot-plan-hsm-seat-vs-throughput.xlsx

I’ll loop in Ben and Jordan for margin guidance and to lock the exact structure.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134
https://redwood.ai
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@medicos.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medicos.com
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Structuring incentives for HIPAA + HSM pilot

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the note and attachments — received. A few quick clarifications from procurement:

1) We cannot accept a large one-time implementation credit upfront against an invoice; procurement prefers credits realized as discounts over invoices or as service credits applied after milestone acceptance.
2) Can you confirm what evidence you’ll provide for SOC2 / HIPAA attestation during pilot? Our audit team will need a short checklist.
3) For HSM seats, we’re more comfortable with a throughput-linked discount than per-seat discounts for the pilot period.

If you can send a revised proposal that shows (a) credits amortized over the first 3 invoices, or (b) throughput credits with an invoice credit cap, that will help speed approval. We’ll try to get a PO to you by 9 June but can only commit once terms map to our invoice cadence.

Best,
Maria Gomez
Director of Platform Engineering — Medicos Health
maria.gomez@medicos.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Structuring incentives for HIPAA + HSM pilot (internal)

Monica — quick internal take before we respond to Maria / procurement:

- Margin constraints: We can do a $25k implementation credit at list, but recommend structuring it as a $10k upfront invoice credit + $15k as a credit applied across the first 3 invoices (to satisfy procurement’s preference). That preserves revenue recognition and reduces cash exposure.
- HSM: Offer a hybrid option — 40% off HSM seats for months 1–3 OR a throughput credit of $0.80 per 1M tokens with a $12k cap. Make the capacity credit convertible to seat discounts if they convert to production within 90 days.
- Audit logs / SOC2: Provide a short evidence bundle (SOC2 summary + attestation checklist) and a proposed acceptance milestone they sign off on at pilot completion (we already have these artifacts; I’ll attach pointer).

Trade-offs: the blended approach (smaller upfront + amortized credit) is easiest for procurement. If they insist on invoice-only credits, we can push to amortize across invoices but capture conversion to production to claw back if no conversion.

If you want, I can run the final numbers for ARR impact and send a deck.

-ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: banter (sic) monica.patel@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Jun 2028 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Structuring incentives for HIPAA + HSM pilot (internal)

Agree with Ben. Two small addenda to recommend back to Medicos:

1) Condition credits on production cutover within 90 days of pilot end; otherwise remaining credits expire (protects against indefinite pilots).
2) Include a one-time SLA uplift clause (90th percentile latency SLA for pilot) as a paid add-on option they can elect; it’s high value and preserves pricing integrity.

I’ll prepare a DocuSign envelope with the revised terms once you confirm the numbers, Monica.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Commercial Lead, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@medicos.com>, procurement@medicos.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Structuring incentives for HIPAA + HSM pilot — revised proposal and next steps

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a revised draft that aligns with procurement preferences:

- Implementation credit: $25,000 total, split as $10,000 invoice credit upon execution + $15,000 applied as credits across first 3 invoices (clear line items showing credit amounts).
- HSM pilot concession: choose either (A) 40% off HSM seats months 1–3, or (B) throughput credit at $0.80 per 1M tokens with a $12,000 cap. Credits convert to the alternative option if Medicos signs and moves to production within 90 days of pilot completion.
- Audit logs / evidence: Included SOC2 summary and a one‑page attestation checklist; pilot acceptance milestone defined in Section 3 of the attached terms.
- Conversion clause: Unused credits are forfeited unless production cutover happens within 90 days; we’ll include a one‑time option to extend to 120 days for a de‑minimis fee.

Next steps:
1) I’ve created a DocuSign envelope for the revised terms: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123 (placeholder).
2) If procurement approves the invoice-credit split, we need PO submission by EOD 9 June to lock pilot pricing and reserve HSM capacity.
3) I’ll log the updated terms on the HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4321

If procurement needs to see a sample invoice showing the credit line items, I can generate that and attach it. Please let me know which HSM concession Medicos prefers (seat discount vs throughput credit) and whether the PO timeline looks feasible.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134
